cwe_content.cwe: CWE-78,Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

candidate.Reason: The code directly concatenates user-controlled input (app.GIT_PATH) into a command string without proper sanitization, which can lead to OS command injection.
The code constructs a command string by concatenating user-controlled input (git_path and args) without proper sanitization, which can lead to OS command injection.

candidate.Code:
p = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,

candidate.Reason: The code uses shell=True with subprocess.Popen, which makes it vulnerable to shell injection if the command string contains user-controlled input.
